community_snippets.title: Letterboxd review of The Revenant
community_snippets.snippet: [Letterboxd Review of "The Revenant"] One of the most criminally under-seen films of recent time. This little known gem holds the awards for Best Gun Brawl Ever and Most Inventive Use Of A Sex Toy Ever. And it probably beats Casino for the number of F-words in a single film. The two leads have serious chemistry, creating a bromance that beats most others (yes, even the Lethal Weapon lads), and director Kerry Prior drenches everything in grubby greens and crimson red, while directing an intelligent if over-long script.Good stuff. I recommend it to all!

community_snippets.snippet: The Revenant: Directed by Alejandro G. Iñárritu. With Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Hardy, Will Poulter, Domhnall Gleeson. A frontiersman on a fur trading expedition in the 1820s fights for survival after being mauled by a bear and left for dead by members of his own hunting team.
